notes.title: Astral Tournament - is now available on Steam as DLC!
notes.content:
This DLC contains a special collection build of Astral Tournament game dedicated to it's 20th anniversary (first published on SEP-23-2002). This is the first game of the Astral games series and the predecessor of Astral Masters game. It's a full version without any DRM.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2160780/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2160780/[/url]
